stats.fact: Stormy Cookbook launched July 27, 2026 on GitHub with 72 stars and MIT license
Covers 6 social networks: TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Reddit — one unified REST API and MCP server
Pricing: $0.01/cached result, $0.05/fresh profile, $0.08/fresh discovery, $0.15/verified email (charged only on success)
Monthly retainer: $50/month with $25 included usage (2,500 credits)

10 copy-pasteable recipes: influencer discovery, outreach lists, CRM enrichment, competitor analysis, monitoring, cross-platform research, Reddit listening, durable jobs, MCP agent workflows, error handling
MCP server supports 10 tools: search_people, lookup_profile, find_emails, estimate_price, account_status, describe_social_data, start_social_job, get_social_job, list_social_jobs, cancel_social_job
Apify MCP Server (main competitor) has 2,296 stars but covers general web scraping, not social-media-specific
Stormy uses Streamable HTTP MCP transport — compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, ChatGPT custom connectors, and any MCP client
Durable jobs system for 25+ paid results, email batches, or long-running work — with idempotency keys and polling

angles: Stormy eliminates the 'six APIs, six auth schemes, six rate limits' problem for AI agents needing social data
Pay-per-result pricing means agents only pay for successful outcomes — no wasted spend on failed requests
The cookbook format (10 copy-pasteable recipes) makes it uniquely accessible for developers vs raw API docs
MCP-native design means any MCP-compatible agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT) can use it without custom integration code
Durable jobs system enables large-scale social data collection without holding HTTP connections open
Verified email finding (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube) is a standout feature for influencer marketing and lead generation workflows
Stormy is brand new (July 2026) — early adopter opportunity with room to grow alongside the platform
The 'cache-first' approach with $0.01 cached results makes repeated queries economical for monitoring and dashboards
